name: hero-video-dialog
title: Hero Video Dialog
description: A hero video thumbnail with a play button that opens the video in an animated dialog.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HeroVideoDialog } from '@/components/ui/hero-video-dialog'
</script>

<template>
  <HeroVideoDialog
    animation-style="from-center"
    video-src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/OrxmtDw4pVI"
    thumbnail-src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/OrxmtDw4pVI/maxresdefault.jpg"
    thumbnail-alt="Hero video"
  />
</template>

examples.name: hero-video-dialog-styles
examples.title: All animation styles
examples.description: Pick a style, then open the video.

props.name: animationStyle
props.description: How the dialog enters and leaves. `top-in-bottom-out` and `left-in-right-out` exit on the opposite side.

props.name: videoSrc
props.description: URL of the video, loaded in an iframe. For YouTube use the embed URL (`https://www.youtube.com/embed/<id>`).

props.name: thumbnailSrc
props.description: URL of the thumbnail image (for YouTube: `https://i.ytimg.com/vi/<id>/maxresdefault.jpg`).

props.name: thumbnailAlt
props.description: Alt text for the thumbnail; also labels the dialog.

emits.name: close
emits.description: The dialog closed (close button, Escape or a click on the backdrop).
